verdicts.reason: Both move the 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow below the headline, which breaks the reading order, and shrink it to near-illegible microtype; both also squeeze the logo into a tiny bar and push the divider up above the headline. In A, the body copy is set almost as large as the headline, so it competes as a second focal point, and the CTA pill nearly touches both canvas edges. B keeps the body copy clearly smaller than the headline and gives the CTA proper side margins, so its hierarchy is cleaner.
